description: URL migration QA server: discover a site's URLs (crawl, sitemap, Google Search Console), review the merged URL set, then compare every path against a new domain and inspect per-URL verdicts (OK / Redirected / Missing / Error), redirect chains, and summaries.
instructions: Workflow: discover_urls → get_job_status (until completed → url_set_id) → optional list_discovered_urls / update_url_set → start_comparison(url_set_id or source_urls, new_domain) → get_job_status → get_comparison_report. check_url = single synchronous spot-check. Jobs are async — poll; never assume instant results. GSC needs a connected account (gsc_not_connected → web UI).
